empty_state_text: an answer with no features (never seen: the layer keeps every parish on every date group)
terms_note: GOHSEP's website terms (read 2026-09-27) make its information available as a public service, let anyone view, copy or distribute it for personal or informational use if it is not modified, and say nothing against reading it with software. The layer is public on ArcGIS Online (no license or access note on the item).
notes: Found by searching ArcGIS Online for 'School System Closures' (the Governor's Office of Homeland Security and Emergency Preparedness also publishes a dashboard and layer per incident: 24-006 and 25-007 Winter Weather, 21-019 TC Nicholas and others) and then its service directory (services1.arcgis.com/fXHQyq63u0UsTeSM, 255 services), which holds a standing 'Parish_School_Closures_Public_View_Layer'. A statewide official list, seen with closures today. It lists parish school systems (districts), so under the district rule it should count only those districts' schools, which needs the coverage measure to take NCES district IDs. Built in round 2 as gohsep-parish-schools, a district-level source counting the 64 parish school systems' 1,137 schools (their LEAIDs); proven by the live read (populated, 640 rows).
